app.title: Mega Idle Plus
app.subtitle: Next-Gen Steam Trading Card Farming Platform

header.onlineTitle: Steam Status: Online (In-game visible to friends)
header.silentOnlineTitle: Steam Status: Silent Online (Shows Online, hides game popups from friends)
header.invisibleTitle: Steam Status: Invisible (Shows offline to friends, cards drop)
header.quickSwitchTitle: Click to quickly switch between accounts

activeFarming.rateLimitDesc: Automatic cooldown active for safety. Farming will resume automatically once timer expires.
activeFarming.descWarmup: Games under 2 hours are being fast-forwarded in batches of 32. Drops are tracked live.
activeFarming.descSimultaneous: Games in your queue are simulated simultaneously (up to 32 games). Games that finish drops are auto-replaced.
activeFarming.descReady: Click start button to begin farming trading cards in your library.

queue.restoreAllTitle: Restores all hidden games back to active queue
queue.dragHint: You can drag and drop games by the "⋮⋮" handle to change their farming order.
queue.noHiddenDesc: Games you hide from the active queue appear here and are skipped during farming.
queue.noQueueDesc: Click Scan Steam Badges to load games with remaining card drops or check your filters.

market.betaTooltip: Untested: This feature has not been fully tested yet; there is a high likelihood of unexpected issues or errors.
market.autoSellDesc: As soon as a card drops, market price is fetched and an order is listed undercut by the specified margin.
market.multiLootDesc: Transfer all trading cards collected in sub/bot accounts to your master account with one click.
market.dropHistoryDesc: Total dropped and inventory trading cards
market.deduplicateConfirm: Duplicate card records will be removed from the database. Continue?
market.filterNoResults: No card drops found for the selected account.
market.syncPromptScanning: Scanning Steam inventory and syncing cards...
market.clearHistoryConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear card drop history? (You can then click Sync from Inventory to cleanly reload only your actual cards)
market.alertSelectAccounts: Please select source and target accounts.
market.alertSameAccount: Source and target account cannot be the same.
market.profilePrivateWarning: Your Steam Profile or Inventory is set to Private! To scan inventory cards, please set your Inventory to 'Public' in Steam Privacy Settings or refresh your session cookies.

logs.title: Event & Farming Logs
logs.noFilteredLogs: No logs match the selected filters.
logs.filterHint: Click: Toggle hide/show (Struck-through are hidden). Double-click: Show only this.

accounts.title: Steam Account Manager
accounts.standaloneDesc: Connects directly to Steam network without Steam client.
accounts.localClientDesc: Operates using running Steam desktop client and cookies.
accounts.toLocalTitle: Switch to Local Client Mode (Steam client must be running)
accounts.toStandaloneTitle: Switch to Standalone Mode (Works without Steam client)
accounts.modeLockedCookie: 🔒 Cookie login — only Local Client mode supported
accounts.modeLockedQR: 🔒 QR/Password login — only Standalone mode supported
accounts.modesGuideStandaloneDesc: No Steam desktop app required. Connects directly to Steam servers for silent background farming.
accounts.modesGuideLocalDesc: Runs alongside your open Steam desktop app and browser cookies.
accounts.qrScanDesc: Open Steam Mobile app on your phone, go to Steam Guard tab and scan this QR code.
accounts.qrSecurityNoteDesc: Mega Idle Plus connects as a desktop Steam client. Per Steam's security policy, newly authorized desktop devices may receive a temporary market/trade hold (cooldown). For instant access without any new-device restrictions, consider using 'Cookie Login'.
accounts.cookieSecurityBadge: 🛡️ Zero Restrictions: Reuses your browser's existing trusted session, so Steam will not trigger any new device holds.
accounts.cookieInstructions: Copy cookies from your browser after logging in to steamcommunity.com (F12 > Application > Cookies).
accounts.removeAccountConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this account?
accounts.removeAccountModalDesc: Are you sure you want to remove this account from Mega Idle Plus? Local session credentials and settings will be deleted from this computer. (Your actual Steam account is not affected)
accounts.errorEmptyCookies: Please enter both sessionid and steamLoginSecure cookie values.
accounts.errorExpired: Steam session could not be verified! The cookies you entered are expired or invalid. Please copy fresh cookies from your browser.
accounts.errorInvalidFormat: Invalid steamLoginSecure value! Cookie must contain a valid 17-digit SteamID64 in '7656119...||...' format.
accounts.errorTimeout: Connection to Steam servers timed out. Please check your internet connection.

settings.title: App & Protection Settings
settings.defaultModeDesc: Select how the farming engine connects and simulates games by default.
settings.modeStandaloneDesc: Runs silently and directly via Steam servers even if Steam client is closed.
settings.modeLocalDesc: Runs using open Steam desktop application and browser session cookies.
settings.modeCookieDisabledTooltip: Your active account was logged in with cookies and cannot connect directly to Steam CM servers; only Local Client mode is supported.
settings.strategyDesc: Choose whether the engine idles games solo, batch warms up, or simulates simultaneously.
settings.strategySmartHybridDesc: Batch warms up games under 2 hours (up to 32), then switches to solo idling for drops.
settings.strategySoloOnlyDesc: Always runs games one by one in queue order regardless of playtime. Keeps active game list minimal.
settings.strategyWarmupOnlyDesc: Only fast warms up games under 2 hours in 32-game batches, then automatically completes.
settings.strategySimultaneousDesc: Simulates up to 32 games from the queue at the same time continuously.
settings.filterVacDesc: Never idles VAC games like CS2, TF2, Rust.
settings.autoPauseDesc: Pauses farming while you play games on PC.
settings.personaSilentOnline: 🤫 Silent Online (Shows Online, hides game popups from friends)
settings.personaInvisible: 👁 Invisible (Recommended - Shows offline, cards still drop)
settings.personaTip: 💡 When "Silent Online" is chosen, your friends see you normally Online and you can chat freely, but your game activity is kept private so no "Started playing X" popups are broadcasted. When "Invisible" is chosen, you appear offline to friends.
settings.cookiePersonaWarn: Notice: Accounts in Cookie (Local Client) mode cannot connect directly to Steam Friends servers. To appear "Online" or "In-Game" in your friends list, please connect the account via QR Code (Standalone).
settings.multiInstanceDesc: When enabled, clicking 'Start Farming' runs card farming on all connected Steam accounts in parallel background sessions.
settings.trayLabel: Minimize to System Tray on close

messages.cardDroppedToast: Congratulations! A new trading card has dropped!
messages.noAccount: Please add a Steam account to begin card farming.
messages.allCompleted: Great job! All trading cards in your library have been dropped.

steamAlert.errorGeneric: An error occurred while connecting to Steam servers. Check your account or restart the application.
steamAlert.tokenErrorMsg: The Steam refresh token is no longer valid. Please remove the account and add it again (via QR or Cookie).
steamAlert.privateProfileMsg: The Steam inventory could not be read because the profile is set to private. Open your inventory visibility in Steam privacy settings.
steamAlert.disconnectedMsg: Connection to Steam CM servers was lost. The app is automatically reconnecting...
steamAlert.sessionReplacedMsg: A login was detected from the official Steam desktop app or another device. Card farming was safely paused. You can click '▶ Start Farming' anytime when ready, or switch the account to 'Cookie (Local Client)' mode to farm simultaneously.

profitFinder.title: Profitable Games Discovery Engine
profitFinder.subtitle: Discovers games where the total market value of dropped cards exceeds the Steam store purchase price.
profitFinder.loading: Scanning profitable games and live market prices...
profitFinder.noGames: No profitable games found matching the selected criteria.
